body:
## Why
The durable half of the board must travel with a `git clone`, so it lives on a dedicated branch written without a checkout (`docs/local-first.md` §6.1, §6.2, measured in §11).

## What
`src/store/git.js`, exporting a `GitTier` used by the local store (A6 composes it with A5's index):
- `readTree()` → `{ tip, board, cards: Map<id, card>, runs: Map<id, run> }` from `refs/heads/kb-board` (`git cat-file --batch` over the tree; one process per read of the whole tree, never one per file).
- `commit(mutate, message)`: takes the current tip, applies a mutation to an in-memory copy of the tree, writes it with `hash-object -w` / `update-index --add --cacheinfo` against a temporary index (`GIT_INDEX_FILE`) / `write-tree` / `commit-tree -p <tip>` / `update-ref refs/heads/kb-board <new> <tip>`; a CAS refusal ("cannot lock ref" / "is at X but expected Y") re-reads and retries, up to 5 times, then throws with `.exitCode = 2` naming the other writer.
- `init(slug, host)`: creates the branch from an empty tree with `board.json` when it does not exist.
- The layouts of §6.2 exactly: `board.json`, `cards/<id>.json`, `runs/<id>.json`, sorted keys, two-space JSON, trailing newline. Integer ids allocated from `board.json.next_id`.
- Root: `storeRoot(ctx)` from A3 (the common git dir's parent); all git calls run there with `GIT_DIR` unset, so a linked worktree writes the same branch as the main checkout.
- Read-only mode: when `board.json.host` is not this host (`hostId()` in `src/board.js`), `commit()` throws exit 2 naming `hkb init --take-over`.

Tests (`test/store-git.test.js`): a scratch repo per test (`git init` in a temp dir, one commit, a linked worktree); commit from the worktree leaves `git status --porcelain` empty; two concurrent `commit()` calls both land (one retries); a clone of the scratch repo can `readTree()` from `origin/kb-board`; read-only refusal on another host; and the conformance suite's durable scenarios (register the driver in `DRIVERS` for the methods this tier owns).

## Done when
- [ ] `npm test` green, including `test/store.test.js` with the git driver for the durable methods.
- [ ] No `git checkout`, `git add` or working-tree write anywhere in the module.
- [ ] A commit is one process chain per write; a read is one `cat-file --batch`.

## Contract
Exactly the layouts and file names of §6.2, and the method names of §6.4 for what this tier implements (`board`, `setBoard`, `listTasks`, `listClosedRecent`, `getTask`, `createTask`, `updateBody`, `setStatus`, `setAgent`, `addLabels`, `removeLabel`, `closeTask`, `reopenTask`, `addBlockedBy`, `removeBlockedBy`, `loadRun`, `saveRun`, `latestResult`, `parentResults`, `addNote`, `listNotes`). Locks, heartbeats and events are **not** this tier's (A5). A5 runs beside you: touch nothing outside your `paths`.

**Read first:** `docs/local-first.md` (the plan; the sections named below), `docs/wiki/decisions/adr-005-control-plane.md`,
`docs/wiki/decisions/adr-006-local-store.md`, `CLAUDE.md`. Keep it dependency-free at runtime. Pure logic in
`src/model.js` with a test. Errors name the fix and carry `.exitCode`. `--json` everywhere. Update the wiki page a
change touches (`node .repolore/scripts/wiki-check.mjs` lists what went stale); a new feature gets a new page.
Finish with `npm run lint && npm test` green, one draft PR, and exactly one terminal verb.
goal: src/store/git.js reads and writes board.json, cards/<id>.json and runs/<id>.json on refs/heads/kb-board with commit-tree + update-ref CAS from a linked worktree; the conformance suite of test/store.test.js passes for the durable methods
title: The git tier: src/store/git.js — the kb-board branch written with plumbing from any worktree
